organization_note: The Chinese About Us page says 北京加速进化科技有限公司成立 in June 2023 and the Chinese privacy policy names 北京加速进化科技有限公司 as the controller of personal information on the site, while the English pages name Booster Robotics Technology Co., Ltd, so this is one entity and the record names no parent. No page read states a headquarters in words or gives a postal address: the English privacy policy says it has "deployed servers in China, Singapore and other regions" and gives only "the place where our company is located" as the venue for a complaint to a court, and the About Us page names investors with Beijing and Shenzhen in their names, which is not a statement of where the company is based. The record takes China from the controller's registered name, whose leading 北京 is its registration locality, and records no city. It is recorded on the reviewed robot booster-t1 rather than on a release because the catalog reviews no model release of its own: Booster publishes policy-training and deployment code, not a model release. Its site names no frontier-safety or scaling framework, so the field is omitted.
